Name: Gingerbears
Author: minathri
Description:
Abandoned, up for adoption

With this mod, you can get in the holiday spirit by making gingerbears!

[b][u]INGREDIENTS:

[/u][/b]Flour x1
Sugar x1
Maple Syrup x1
Egg (any) x1
Ginger x1

[b]Makes ONE cookie!

[/b]Qi-enhanced regular cookies are 65 edibility, these are 85 edibility AND increase luck by 1.

You won't be making any profit from these, but aside from being a decent heal item, the vanilla giftable NPCs all love these, as does Morris.

Downloads.Description: Gingerbear cookies! Re-uploaded with update key now.
